# Fields of the World Benchmark Data

> Training and evaluation chips for field boundary delineation models, one collection per country, published as a Portolan catalog.

- [Catalog README](README.md)
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/fieldsoftheworld/benchmark-data-catalog)

## Collections

<!-- collections:start -->
- [Austria](at/collection.json): 11242 chips (9018/1153/1071 train/val/test), CC-BY-4.0
- [Luxembourg](lu/collection.json): 775 chips (601/79/95 train/val/test), CC-BY-4.0
- [Slovenia](si/collection.json): 5103 chips (4078/512/513 train/val/test), other
<!-- collections:end -->
